title: The Grunion Run, v
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Fifth year. Gully's back. The buckets. Wood draws the two of them from behind — the first time he draws himself from behind.

panels.composition: The beach, lanterns, the run. GULLY with buckets, back in it. WOOD. BARNABY in the surf.

balloons.text: I know. It was on the porch. Quarter full.

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns and silver fish, a young man in a backwards cap with buckets grinning, another with a drawing pad, a small dog in the surf, brush-pen black and white

balloons.text: They were all leaving. It's harder than it looks.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man with a drawing pad admitting something, lantern light

panels.composition: The pad: the two of them from behind, at the surf line, drawn as if by a third person. The first time Wood draws himself from the back.

image.notes: The first from-behind self-drawing. It returns in the ROFLCOPTER pages.

panels.composition: Silent. The surf. The fish. The two backs. The dog. The lanterns.
